summary: The manuscript provides an outstanding, mathematically rigorous, and fully machine-checked critique and repair of recent claims regarding minimum average time broadcast graphs (MATBGs) on deleted Knödel graphs. It identifies three fundamental infinite-family obstructions that invalidate Altay et al.'s general MATBG claim, while establishing constructive repairs (shortcut rerouting and 2-adic boundary shifts) and proving gap-free MATBG results for 2^k-5 and 2^k-3. All 24 universal theorems are formally verified in zero-dependency Lean 4, complemented by an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier with 16 canonical certificates. The paper sets an exemplary standard for formal rigor and reproducibility in theoretical computer science.
weaknesses: The interior band [3 * 2^(k-2), 2^k - 6] remains an open problem for a universal collision-free MATBG family, though the present work significantly narrows and illuminates the structural bottlenecks.
